blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Igneous rocks are formed from the cooling and solidification of molten material known as magma.
Known as primary rocks because all other categories of rocks are derived from them.
Represent the oldest rock formations on Earth.
Completely lack fossils but are highly rich in minerals.
Frequently tested: Igneous rocks do NOT contain fossils due to their thermal origin.
Remember that Igneous rocks are termed 'Primary Rocks' as they serve as the parent material for sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.
Questions often test the high mineral content and erosion resistance characteristic of igneous formations.
